# Marks

O2 examples and composition boundaries. The comment composition landed with
O3; generated heading anchors belong to P3; callout titles belong to O8.

```````````````````````````````` example
This is ==important== text.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="This is " children=0
    ├── Mark scope=1:9..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="important" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:22..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" text." children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==a *b* c==
.
Document scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Mark scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
        ├── Text scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
        ├── Emphasis scope=1:5..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        │   └── Text scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
        └── Text scope=1:8..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
a==b==c ==d====e==
.
Document scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── Mark scope=1:2..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:7..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c " children=0
    ├── Mark scope=1:9..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d" children=0
    └── Mark scope=1:14..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:16..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="e" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==a===b==

=a= ===a=== ====
.
Document scope=1:1..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Mark scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:6..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="=b==" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=3:1..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="=a= =" children=0
    ├── Mark scope=3:6..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=3:8..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    └── Text scope=3:11..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="= ====" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
==a==b==
.
Document scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Mark scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:6..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b==" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
if a == b and c == d
.
Document scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="if a == b and c == d" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
\==a== ==a\==
.
Document scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="==a== ==a==" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A comment is an earlier class-A step, so a mark whose content is one
`Comment` is a mark (the module's example, exact since O3):

```````````````````````````````` example
==%%c%%==
.
Document scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Mark scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Comment scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
http://x/?a==b== c
.
Document scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://x/?a==b==") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="http://x/?a==b==" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:17..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
`==a==` $==b==$
.
Document scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Code scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="==a==" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Formula scope=1:9..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="==b==" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Nested, adjacent, mixed and crossed delimiter runs

```````````````````````````````` example
====a==== ===a===

==**bold** ~~gone~~ _em_ :badge[label]==

*==inside==* ==*inside*==

**==cross**== ==**cross==**

==a====b===c==
.
Document scope=1:1..9:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Mark scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Mark scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:10..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" =" children=0
│   ├── Mark scope=1:12..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:14..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:17..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="=" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:40 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Mark scope=3:1..3:40 anchor=null attributes={} children=7
│       ├── Strong scope=3:3..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       │   └── Text scope=3:5..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bold" children=0
│       ├── Text scope=3:11..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│       ├── Strikethrough scope=3:12..3:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       │   └── Text scope=3:14..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="gone" children=0
│       ├── Text scope=3:20..3:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│       ├── Emphasis scope=3:21..3:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       │   └── Text scope=3:22..3:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal="em" children=0
│       ├── Text scope=3:25..3:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│       └── Directive scope=3:26..3:38 anchor=null attributes={} name="badge" children=0
│           └── DirectiveLabel scope=3:32..3:38 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│               └── Text scope=3:33..3:37 anchor=null attributes={} literal="label" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Emphasis scope=5:1..5:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Mark scope=5:2..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=5:4..5:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="inside" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=5:13..5:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Mark scope=5:14..5:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Emphasis scope=5:16..5:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=5:17..5:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="inside" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Strong scope=7:1..7:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=7:3..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="==cross" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=7:12..7:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="== " children=0
│   ├── Mark scope=7:15..7:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=7:17..7:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal="**cross" children=0
│   └── Text scope=7:26..7:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="**" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Mark scope=9:1..9:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=9:3..9:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── Mark scope=9:6..9:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=9:8..9:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    └── Text scope=9:11..9:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="=c==" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Non-empty source, maximal runs and flanking

```````````````````````````````` example
==== a====b == == =a= ==

== a== ==a == == a ==

前==中==后 ==（中）==。 == a== ==a ==

==!a!==!b!==

\==x== ==x\== \===x==
.
Document scope=1:1..9:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal="==== a====b == == =a= ==" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:1..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="== a== ==a == == a ==" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:46 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
│   ├── Text scope=5:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="前" children=0
│   ├── Mark scope=5:4..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=5:6..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="中" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=5:11..5:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="后 " children=0
│   ├── Mark scope=5:15..5:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=5:17..5:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="（中）" children=0
│   └── Text scope=5:28..5:46 anchor=null attributes={} literal="。 == a== ==a ==" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Mark scope=7:1..7:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=7:3..7:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="!a!" children=0
│   └── Text scope=7:8..7:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="!b!==" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Text scope=9:1..9:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="==x== ==x== =" children=0
    └── Mark scope=9:17..9:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=9:19..9:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Opaque bodies and enabled content between HTML tags

```````````````````````````````` example
`==code==` ``==`code`==`` $==formula==$ $$==display==$$

\\(==latex==\\) \\[==latex==\\]

<i title="==attribute==">==body==</i> <!-- ==comment== -->

[[==path==|==label==]] ![[Note#==anchor==|==label==]]

==`code` $math$ <i>x</i> <!--body--> [[Note]]==

==<!--body-->==

<https://x/?a==b==> http://x/?a==b== ==[link](/a==b==)==
````````````````````````````````

## Setext precedence and headings before P3

```````````````````````````````` example
==text
==

## ==a== b
.
Document scope=1:1..4:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Heading scope=1:1..2:2 anchor=null attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="==text" children=0
└── Heading scope=4:1..4:10 anchor=null attributes={} level=2 children=2
    ├── Mark scope=4:4..4:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=4:6..4:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    └── Text scope=4:9..4:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Table cells and referenced footnote content

```````````````````````````````` example
| ==a== | ==b== |
| --- | --- |
| ==中\|x== | ==c	**d**== |
| ==open | close== |

Use[^n].

[^n]: ==foot *note*==
.
Document scope=1:1..8:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Table scope=1:1..4:20 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=3
│   ├── TableHead children=1
│   │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │       │   └── Mark scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       │       └── Text scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│   │       └── TableCell scope=1:10..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Mark scope=1:11..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │               └── Text scope=1:13..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````
